notes.title: Half Past Fate: Romantic Distancing Now Available!
notes.content:
[h2]Though Stephen and Robin are apart, there's still love to be found in the digital domain![/h2]

This Valentine's Day, join their journey as they figure out what it means to share their lives online! Follow their story as they pick up new hobbies, spend time with roommates, and get to know each other's weird musical tastes! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WtFyM12.jpg[/img]

We're so excited to bring this new entry in the [i]Half Past Fate[/i] series to you all! Stephen and Robin's story is one of challenging times and circumstances, but a message of hope in forming a relationship, despite the distance between them. Like the first [i]Half Past Fate[/i], their meeting looks at the nature of just how people happen to meet at the right times in the right places! That spark forms, a connection is made, and, well, it's up to you to find out the rest! We hope you enjoy our little slice-of-love story <3

For the first week only, get [i]Half Past Fate: Romantic Distancing[/i] [b]17% off![/b]

If you haven't played the original [i]Half Past Fate[/i], you can check it out here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1048740/Half_Past_Fate/
